def: Open-source tracing conventions and auto-instrumentation plugins from Arize that complement OpenTelemetry, defining AI span kinds such as LLM, retriever, tool and agent across many frameworks and SDKs.
practice: Native to Arize Phoenix and usable with any OpenTelemetry backend; its attributes differ from the OpenTelemetry GenAI gen_ai.* conventions, so mixing the two needs a mapping.
